task: CHASSIS-02: prepare isolated ENCOS motor-4 identification and four-motor split-bus driving.
changes: Extend the existing read-only query and one-shot ID-assignment CLIs with --can-bus 1|2; retain legacy CAN1 defaults.
Use the same exclusive interface lock as MotorBus; verify isolated OLD_ID discovery before a persistent ID write; no brake, timeout, zero or firmware writes.
Keep unused transmit passages empty. Receive entries have no verified CAN-bus source tag, so protocol/ID matching retains all-entry scanning rather than assuming input-slot placement.
Extend the existing commissioning module with ID-4-only and all-four 5 RPM, 2 A, one-second positive/negative tests, signed-feedback and stop checks, and cached JSON evidence on success/failure.
Add an explicit four-motor split-bus profile with no omission, and forward it through the existing launcher to driver, keyboard and read-only viewer.
Preserve the historical three-motor profile/default launcher, motor leases, native slew, current limits and latched faults.
